archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast modified for Premium Service)
design_philosophy: Crisp, authoritative, and impeccably clean. The UI should mirror a freshly pressed suit: high contrast, zero clutter, and perfectly aligned. We reject generic 'laundry' tropes and instead present a premium 'clothing care studio'.

primary.name: Deep Navy
primary.usage: Primary text, dark sections, high-impact headings.

secondary.name: Teal / Aqua
secondary.usage: CTAs, hover states, active indicators, WhatsApp button.

headings.usage: Hero typography, section headers. Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight).

rules: No Inter or Poppins for headings to ensure a bespoke, non-template feel.
H1 should scale fluidly up to text-6xl, never larger.
Overlines must be uppercase, tracking-[0.2em], text-xs or text-sm.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Mode A (Tetris Grid) for Services and About section to break monotony. Asymmetrical layouts preferred over perfect symmetry.

surfaces_and_components.cards: Flat design. No heavy drop shadows. Use 1px border-slate-200 with bg-white or bg-slate-50. On hover, use a subtle -translate-y-1 and shadow-lg.
surfaces_and_components.header: Crystal Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80, 1px border-b border-slate-200. Sticky at top.
surfaces_and_components.buttons: Sharp or slightly rounded (rounded-md). Primary CTA uses Teal (bg-[#0D9488]) with white text. Hover state must increase contrast (e.g., bg-[#0F766E]).
surfaces_and_components.forms: Use Shadcn UI forms. Clean input fields with 1px borders. Focus states must ring with Teal.

animations.scroll: Smooth scrolling via Lenis. Framer Motion for fade-up on scroll (y: 20, opacity: 0 -> 1).
animations.interactions: Micro-interactions on buttons and service cards. Image zoom on hover inside overflow-hidden containers.
animations.how_it_works: Sequential stagger animations for the 4-step process.

hero.usage: Hero section split-screen or large featured visual.

service_wash_fold.description: Stack of fresh white folded towels

about_texture.description: Close up of pure white fabric texture
about_texture.usage: Background or accent image for the About Us or Testimonial section.

page_structure.details: Sticky top, logo left, nav center, 'Book Now' right. bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl.
Headline 'Premium Care for Your Clothes'. Subtext establishing trust and hygiene. Two CTAs (Book Pickup (Teal), View Pricing (Outline)). Split layout with the suit jacket image.
Bento grid (col-span-1 to col-span-2) showcasing Dry Cleaning, Wash & Fold, Steam Ironing, Shoe Cleaning, Curtain Cleaning.
4 Steps: 1. Schedule, 2. We Collect, 3. Expert Cleaning, 4. Delivered Fresh. Use icons (lucide-react) and staggering.
Tabs for 'Regular' vs 'Express'. Clean price list format with dotted separators or minimal cards.
Embedded form (Name, Phone, Service Select, Date Picker, Address) with validation. Styled with Shadcn UI.
Carousel of reviews highlighting 'trustworthy, hygienic, fast'.
Deep Blue bg (#0A192F) with white text, detailing the studio's commitment to quality.
Google Maps embed block alongside contact details (+91 1234567890).
WhatsApp button fixed at bottom right, z-50, shadow-2xl.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure white text on Deep Navy and Teal passes WCAG AA.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements must include 'data-testid' (e.g., data-testid='hero-book-button', data-testid='whatsapp-fab').

instructions_to_main_agent: Install 'lucide-react', 'framer-motion', 'lenis' (if implementing smooth scroll), and '@googlemaps/react-wrapper' or simple iframe for maps.
Configure Tailwind with Outfit and DM Sans. Use custom colors defined above.
Do NOT use generic Shadcn Cards blindly. Remove default heavy shadows; use crisp borders or flat backgrounds.
Follow the exact color palette requested by the user, using Deep Blue (#0A192F) for dark structural elements and Teal (#0D9488) for interactions.
Implement the WhatsApp floating button with a pulse animation.
All components must be accessible and responsive (Mobile-first).
